description: This file implements event handling, subscription management, and test routines for RBUS (a messaging system). It defines data structures, event callbacks, subscription functions, and various tests to verify event notification and handling mechanisms within the RBUS framework.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A structure representing an event result, including type, user, name, data, and success status.

methods.name: void freeResult(void * p)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a Result object.

methods.name: void eventHandler(rbusHandle_t handle,rbusEvent_t const * event,rbusEventSubscription_t * subscription)
methods.description: Callback invoked when an rbus event occurs, used for processing and tracking event data and status.

methods.name: void addTestResult(int i,char const * user,char const * name,char const * data,bool ok)
methods.description: Records a new test event result into the global result list.

methods.name: void setTestResult(int i,char const * user,char const * name,char const * data,bool ok)
methods.description: Resets the result list and adds a new test result.

methods.name: void checkTestResult(int wait)
methods.description: Pauses for a specified time and then evaluates the test results, updating pass/fail counts.

methods.name: void testAddRow(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user,char const * name,char const * data,char const * alias)
methods.description: Tests adding a row to a table and verifies event handling.

methods.name: void testAddRowMulti(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user1,char const * user2,char const * user3,char const * name,char const * data,char const * alias)
methods.description: Tests adding multiple rows for multiple users and verifies events.

methods.name: void testRemoveRow(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user,char const * name,char const * data)
methods.description: Tests removing a row from a table and verifies event handling.

methods.name: void testRemoveRowMulti(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user1,char const * user2,char const * user3,char const * name,char const * data)
methods.description: Tests removing multiple rows and verifies event notifications.

methods.name: void testSetStr(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user,char const * name,char const * data,bool ok)
methods.description: Tests setting a string value and verifies event handling.

methods.name: void testSetStrMulti(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user1,char const * user2,char const * user3,char const * name,char const * data,bool ok)
methods.description: Tests setting string values with multiple users and verifies event notifications.

methods.name: void testTableEvents(rbusHandle_t handle)
methods.description: Performs a series of table add/remove event tests.

methods.name: void testTableRemoveAllEvents(rbusHandle_t handle)
methods.description: Removes all table event subscriptions and cleans up.

methods.name: void testSingleValueChange(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user,char const * name,char const * value,bool ok)
methods.description: Tests a single value change event for a specific user.

methods.name: void testMultiValueChange(rbusHandle_t handle,char const * user1,char const * user2,char const * user3,char const * name,char const * value,bool ok)
methods.description: Tests multiple user value change events.

methods.name: void testAllSingleValueChange(rbusHandle_t handle)
methods.description: Runs a sequence of single value change event tests covering expected and unexpected cases.

methods.name: void testAllMultiValueChange(rbusHandle_t handle)
methods.description: Runs multi-user value change event tests.

methods.name: void testAllProviderRegisterRows(rbusHandle_t handle)
methods.description: Tests registration of provider rows and associated event subscriptions.

methods.name: void testEvents(rbusHandle_t handle,int * countPass,int * countFail)
methods.description: Orchestrates a series of event tests and outputs results.

methods.name: int getDurationEvents()
methods.description: unavailable
